centre.reprime_invitation: Today, the center you are working is the instinct of the present: staying with what is, finishing what has been started, feeling fatigue or boredom. Not to suffer — to exist.

dynamique_ego.passion_explication: A gluttony for plans, stimulation, options, ideas. You keep every door open at once. The fear is of missing out — of missing the next thing, more alive, more interesting.
dynamique_ego.peur_de_base: Being trapped in pain, limitation, lack.

essence.qualite_principale: The work of awakening (the present as sufficient)
essence.qualite_phrase: You don't have to flee toward what's next — what is, here, is already enough.
horizons: Staying with what is, without fleeing it
Touching the joy that doesn't depend on novelty

intentions_du_matin: Choose one option and close the others
Stay with a difficulty rather than going around it
Feel boredom without filling it right away
Listen to someone all the way through, without jumping in
Do one thing in depth, not in breadth
Savor what is, without looking at what could be
pratiques_du_matin: Before noon, finish a single task you've started — don't open a new one.
When the urge to skip ahead rises, breathe three times and stay.
One activity through to the end, without diversion (no phone, no different music every 3 minutes).
Feel the fatigue or boredom coming — and do nothing to escape it, for 5 minutes.
Choose ONE thing to savor fully today, and savor it fully.
Before planning what's next, check: am I truly here?

zones.description: Present joy. You savor what is without multiplying it. You know how to stay, finish, feel what is hard. Gratitude is felt, not displayed.
You flit about, you plan, but you see when you're fleeing. You can slow down, finish.
You flee what is heavy. You accumulate options without choosing among them. Scattering becomes frantic. Superficiality sets in.
Destructive impulsiveness, addictions, collapse when escape no longer works. A very heavy day that calls for simple, present support.

details_riso.texte: Grateful, satisfied, free. Joy comes from being, not from doing. You know how to stay with what is difficult too.
Enthusiastic, productive, versatile. Your liveliness serves the life around you.
Multi-talented, practical, generous. Your ideas take shape.
Lightly hedonistic, curious. You begin to favor novelty over depth.
Scattered, insatiable, superficial. You start without finishing. You actively flee boredom.
Selfish, demanding, impatient. You want everything, right now.
Impulsive, addictive, escapist. Anything not to feel.
Manic, hysterical, risky behaviors. Escape becomes compulsive.
Collapse, panic, bare despair. Asking for help is vital here.

passions.label: I flitted from one thing to another
I made a plan to escape the present
I sought out stimulation
passions.detail: So as not to feel bored.

passions.label: I kept too many options open
passions.detail: So as not to choose, and so not to lose.

passions.label: I jumped on other people's words
I 'reframed' a difficulty as positive
passions.detail: So as not to feel it.

pieges.label: I left something half-done
pieges.detail: To move on to something more exciting.

pieges.label: I promised too much, to too many people
I consumed an experience instead of living it

moments.label: I felt boredom without filling it
I chose one option and closed the others
I listened all the way through
I savored what was, without looking elsewhere
Joy was in the present, not in what's next

evenements_a_relire.label: I chose and let go of the other options

remedes.label: Staying — with what is heavy too

matin: Morning begins. What do you want to *finish* today?
A day opens up — can you stay in it without planning the next one?
What do you want to savor fully, without looking elsewhere?
midi: You are in the middle of the day. Are you here, or already elsewhere?
Here you are. What deserves your depth, right now?
A possible pause. Not to plan — to savor.
soir: The day is fading. Have you completed something, peacefully?
You can simply arrive, without bringing anything back.
Evening is gentle. A feeling, without multiplying it.
nuit: Night keeps watch. One true thing, then sleep.
You are still here, without having to flee it.
